dedupe_keys.name: san diego bicycle master plan gis

description: The San Diego Bicycle Master Plan dataset holds the GIS layer of the City of San Diego's Bicycle Master Plan, the planned network of bikeways the city intends to build. It is published by the city's Planning Department on the City of San Diego Open Data Portal, tagged with SanGIS, transit and bike, to share the plan geometry with residents, businesses and researchers. Coverage: the City of San Diego; the dataset was issued on 30 June 2017 and last updated on 11 December 2020, although the page lists a weekly update frequency. Access: downloads as an attribute table in CSV, a shapefile, GeoJSON, a file geodatabase and a REST URL. Licence and cost: free, under the Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License linked from the page. Caveats: no data dictionary is available, so attribute meanings must be inferred, the last update is from 2020 despite the stated frequency, and a master plan shows intentions, not built facilities. It supports scenario studies of future cycling networks, accessibility and investment appraisal, and relates to other City of San Diego open data catalogued here, such as the development permits and approvals record.
